task.brief:
## Captain's intent
The voice assistant reads the weather answer twice when the user asks about tomorrow. Make it answer once.

## Firstmate spec
Root cause is the duplicate `speak()` call in `answer.ts` after the forecast fetch resolves. Remove the second call, add a unit test that asserts one utterance per question, and note the fix in CHANGELOG. Then bump the iOS build number and upload the build to TestFlight.
### Out of scope
Any other assistant behaviour.
